description: This Java class 'ScriptUtil' provides utility methods for executing, compiling, and managing scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It acts as a facade for connecting OFBiz to JSR-223 scripting engines, supporting secure script execution with features like script security, script caching, context creation, and execution handling for various scripting languages like Groovy, JavaScript, and others.

classes.name: ScriptUtil.ProtectedBindings
classes.description: A custom Bindings implementation that protects certain keys from modification, ensuring read-only variables.

methods.name: compileScriptFile
methods.description: Loads and compiles a script file at the specified location, caches the compiled script for reuse.

methods.name: compileScriptString
methods.description: Compiles a script provided as a string for a specific language, with caching.

methods.name: createScriptContext
methods.description: Creates a ScriptContext with user-provided context map, including security bindings.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a script string in a specified language with a given script class and context, supporting Groovy and other scripts.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a pre-compiled script with optional function invocation, manages script context and engine.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a script from a location (file path), with optional function and context, handling different script engines.

methods.name: parseScript
methods.description: Parses a script string into a class, particularly for Groovy scripts.

methods.name: isSafeScript
methods.description: Checks whether a script is deemed safe based on its hash and security policies.

methods.name: checkIfScriptIsSafe
methods.description: Verifies if the script content does not match denied scriptlet tokens, enforcing security.

methods.name: initScriptletsTokensPattern
methods.description: Initializes regex pattern for detecting dangerous scriptlet tokens based on security configuration.

methods.name: initAllowedScriptHashes
methods.description: Loads the list of allowed script hashes from security configuration.
